hooks.prompt_submit: takoctl status set working --text "Thinking..." && takoctl progress indeterminate
hooks.approval_requested: takoctl status set needs_approval --text "Approval requested" && takoctl notify "Codex requested approval" --title "Approval Needed" && takoctl progress pause
hooks.waiting_input: takoctl status set waiting_for_input --text "Waiting for input" && takoctl notify "Codex waiting for input" --title "Input Needed" && takoctl progress clear
hooks.turn_done: takoctl status set done --text "Done" && takoctl notify "Codex completed turn" --title "Codex" && takoctl progress clear
hooks.session_end: takoctl status clear && takoctl progress clear
